svg.title: NET-03 — Locked connecting task
svg.desc: 850 by 700 logical desktop canvas. Common player-hosted and pilot pending connection. Fixed banner, retained endpoint, locked full-width local roster, status and sole Cancel action. Reading order top to bottom. Cancel receives focus. No editable endpoint or credential controls.

g.text: Connection attempt • Local players locked / read-only
Remaining locked rows • Up to 15 slots
ANNOTATIONS: Fixed endpoint, roster headings, status and action. No credential text.
No editing or second Connect. Cancel returns to the owning editable variant with permitted retention.
Use an actual pending attempt. No success claim until verified identity and complete admission.
